hypothesis_candidates.baseline: unchanged core drawdown flow-put stabilization selection
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: exclude or down-rank contemporaneous high Form4 sale-overhang decisions only after fixed forward cohorts mature

hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: high-overhang decisions fail to underperform the complement, either chronological half is nonpositive, concentration exceeds 40%, or any window has fewer than five touches

hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: post-fix rows remain unsettled, mapping is concentrated, probability changes are flat, or replacement value is nonpositive
